review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The proved collision frontier is confined to a highly structured experiment with known two-level amplitudes, uniform cells, deterministic signs, and vanishing triple collisions; for general anchor COT classes the note proves converse lower bounds only, while continuous achievability covers solely its constructed growing-roughness interpolation image. Thus it does not establish a general COT estimation frontier or justify partition refinement when coarsening bias is present, although the framing mostly states these limitations accurately. The interval-certification theorem overstates its quantifier by promising the defined procedure for every truncation m, whereas its displayed Chernoff tail certificate requires m+1>lambda (eventually m+1>lambda_s^+); the theorem must restrict m accordingly or supply a valid exact tail enclosure for arbitrary m. The package also presents an abstract exact-rational certification construction rather than reproducible certified LP witnesses or numerical brackets, weakening the claimed practical auditability and keeping the projected paper score below the strongest field contributions. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.7 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: strip-integral-factor@thm:interpolation-transfer, positioning_missing@thm:deterministic-shell-local-minimax
